text: The Technology Enablement for Agricultural Insurance Operations (2023–2024) initiative in China represents a coordinated effort to digitally transform the agricultural insurance sector. This transformation is driven by the integration of remote sensing, IoT, big data, and AI technologies to enhance the entire insurance process from underwriting to claims. The initiative aims to modernize agricultural risk management, support rural revitalization, and improve smallholder inclusion by providing more efficient and accurate insurance services.
